rows: all 2919 rows of the official splits (no detector is trained; split column is ignored)

statistics.gray: BT.601 luma of the 8-bit RGB crop after the condition, float, no rounding
statistics.hp: valid-region high-pass residual x - mean(4-neighbours), border 1px dropped
statistics.S1: radially averaged power (Hann window), 16 log-spaced bins in f in [1/64, 1/4] cycles/px; alpha = -slope of log10 P vs log10 f; resid = RMS of the fit in log10
statistics.S2: Haar (decimated) detail coefficients H,V,D at levels 1-4 of the gray image: log10 variance and excess kurtosis (db2 not used)
statistics.S3: hp residual of gray; 8 equal-count bins of the 5x5-mean intensity; per bin sigma = 1.4826*MAD(hp)/sqrt(1.25); linear fit vs mean intensity/255 of sigma (primary: s3_slope_sd, s3_icpt_sd) and of sigma^2 (s3_slope_var, s3_icpt_var; the physical Poisson-Gaussian form)
statistics.S4: hp residuals of R,G,B: corr(hpR-hpG, hpB-hpG), corr(hpR,hpG), corr(hpB,hpG); green hp residual energy in the 4 (row%2,col%2) phases: coefficient of variation (s4_phase_cv) and checkerboard contrast |e00+e11-e01-e10|/sum (s4_phase_diag)
statistics.S5: 16x16 non-overlapping patches of gray: Shannon entropy (bits, 32 levels) mean; patch std (local contrast) mean and std

effect_size.ci: cluster bootstrap (experiments/lib/metrics.bootstrap_weights): reals by device (each RAISE image its own cluster), fakes by image within generator; percentile 95%

mmd.kernel: RBF on z-scored features (clipped +-8), bandwidth = median pairwise distance over the 2919 rows of the cell
mmd.holm_over: the 8 generators, per space x arm x condition
mmd.reals: all reals (pre-registered pool); sensitivity: native+RAISE only (no near-duplicate WA/FBH copies)

c2st.model: StandardScaler(fit on train fold, clip +-8) + LogisticRegression(class_weight=balanced, C=1.0 battery / 0.01 DINOv2, lbfgs, max_iter=1000)
c2st.folds: K=4. Real groups (VISION device; RAISE: one group per image) and the 8 generators are shuffled (seeded) and dealt round-robin into 4 folds (generator folds hold 2 generators). A test fold = its real groups + its generators' fakes; training uses only reals of other groups and fakes of other generators. Twin-disjoint pruning in each fold: training fakes whose RAISE twin id is a test-fold RAISE real and training RAISE reals whose id is a test-fold fake twin are dropped. WA/FBH/native copies share a device so stay in one fold.
c2st.metric: AUROC of pooled out-of-fold scores, mean over repeats; 95% CI = cluster bootstrap (1000 replicates) on repeat 0
c2st.sensitivity: plain folds without twin pruning, repeats 3 (battery, dino_b0)

twin.id: regex (r[0-9a-f]{8,}t) on basename(src_path), as in the H4 critic check c4
twin.pairs: RAISE real (any split) x each fake sharing its id, per generator
twin.paired_test: per statistic: sign test (two-sided binomial, ties dropped) on fake-real differences, Holm over the 38 statistics; pooled over generators on the per-id mean difference
twin.paired_c2st: 4 id folds x 4 generator folds = 16 cells; cell (a,b) trains on twin ids not in a, fakes of generators not in b (reals once per id); tests on reals with id in a and twin fakes with id in a and generator in b; AUROC averaged over cells weighted by test pairs; also matched-pair win rate; repeats 5; CI = bootstrap over twin ids on repeat 0

predictions.P1: orig, clean: twin paired C2ST AUROC of the battery >= 0.75 (fov512 reported)
predictions.P2: orig, jpeg75_resize05: battery C2ST < 0.70 AND DINOv2-B0 C2ST < 0.70 AND no generator significant at 0.01 (Holm) for MMD in battery and dino_b0 (all-reals pool). Strict reading: all three on both spaces
predictions.P3: orig, all-reals. P3a: mean |delta| over 8 generators computed per statistic; >=3 of the top-5 clean statistics lie in F={S2L1,S3,S4} AND mean|delta|_clean(F) > mean|delta|_clean(not F). P3b: group ratio = mean|delta|(jpeg75_resize05)/mean|delta|(clean); min(ratio_S1, ratio_S5) > max(ratio_S2L1, ratio_S3, ratio_S4). P3 = P3a and P3b (social_sim, fov512 reported)
predictions.P4: battery C2ST (clean): AUROC(reals=VISION native, orig) - AUROC(reals=WA u RAISE, fov512) >= 0.05; single-factor variants reported
